name: io.github.tonyyang0504/line-messaging-mcp
description: LINE (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Channel access token of the Messaging API channel (long-lived token from the LINE Developers Console, or a short-lived / v2.1 token), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {channel access token}' (securitySchemes Bearer 'Channel access token' in LINE's official OpenAPI description, https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml; https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#send-push-message).
